feature.title: Notifications
feature.problem: Course builds take minutes and project reviews run in the background, and both are built for leaving and coming back. Nothing tells you when one finished or failed: you find out only by reopening the Library or the project. A notifications menu exists from the template but nothing opens it, and the agent service has no notifications at all.
nonGoals: A separate inbox page. The menu holds the history; the template's 'View all' link to /inbox goes.
Browser or OS push notifications, email, or sound.
Notifying every background re-index of a note. Only work you started and are waiting on is worth a notice.

surfaces.name: Notifications
surfaces.route: sidebar row above Search, opens a menu on any screen

moments.peak: the row badge shows 1 and the top line reads 'Rust ownership and borrowing is ready', one click from the course
moments.end: the course open, the notice marked read, the badge gone

surfaces.purpose: See what finished or failed while you were away, and jump to it.

rows: ● ✓ Rust ownership and borrowing is ready
✓ Review ready: Build a Raft log

states.loading: Three row skeletons in the menu; the sidebar row shows no badge until the count is known.
states.empty: Inbox spot drawing: 'You're all caught up. Builds and reviews tell you here when they finish.'
states.error: Compact ErrorState in the menu: 'Notifications didn't load' with Try again; the sidebar row shows no badge.
states.success: Rows newest first, unread on a faint wash with a dot; clicking marks read and opens the course, project or Sources.

components.why: a short list of links opened from one control and dismissed on choice; the existing NotificationsDropdown is already a Menu with rows, unread wash and Mark all read
the app has no topbar; the sidebar footer already holds Search and Tutor as rows, so Notifications sits with them and collapses to an icon like they do
the empty and error states use the same family as every other screen
